Hi,

Markus

additional_info.subject: proactive-ID0367362-DC/Si-D/FI-[acno33] -  DC_Contactor_DC4_QA23-24 & CableTempIssue CRM:00315001561
additional_info.body:
Hi Markus,
That is a good question that I didn't confirm, from the logs, it seems like QA241-242 is not behaving properly, the same is not seen in QA231-232, so these contactors should be replaced:
Now, from the logs+error-flags perspective, I don't know if both pairs are faulty or if there is just one pair. Unless you have some experience in finding this in the logs.
If not, my suggestion would be to take 4 contactors to site:
replace the QA241-24
test a charging session
stop the session
this is where the error appears, after P07→P00.
If the error still persists, then we should also replace the QA23-24.
For the CableTempSensor error:
DC3:
From my perspective, the DC3 should not have a big issue, it only triggered 5 times the last month. To replace this one I would require a visual inspection of the plug since it happened so few times in 1 month. We cannot be sure if it's actually an EV-plug issue. If we see that the contacts are not in good state then I will obviously recommend the replacement.
In contrast we have DC4 with 34 times:
For this one is obvious that it's not good and should be replaced.
I am proactively searching this charger to collect a photo of the temperature sensor from EcoG.
In sum:
Order 4 contactors, QA23-24 and QA241-242.
Order 2 cables DC3 and DC4
In case there is no need to replace DC3, we can ship back to factory without costs.
What is your opinion?
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco

additional_info.body:
Hi Markus,
Sorry again.
Please also order a new TF203 for the dispenser. I need you to verify if the display of the Transducer has any reduced impedance. If yes, then we need to make a wiring check. You can also try and swap TF203 with TF204  and see if the error persists.
If yes, then we should replace the IMD.
If there is anything missing let me know.

additional_info.subject: proactive-ID0367362-DC/Si-D/FI-[acno33] -  DC_Contactor_DC4_QA23-24 & CableTempIssue CRM:00315001561
additional_info.body:
Hi Markus,
A quick update on the CableTempSensor error. From our perspective, I cannot recommend to replace a cable with more than 10 occurrences, this was aligned with Product Champion as it would be massive in costs. First we need to make an assessment of the plug and go from there. It's up to you if you want to take a spare one or not, for the ones that have few occurrences, since (in this case) it occurred only once per week (for DC3). For DC4 it's clear to me that we should order a new CCS cable.
In sum, from TechSupport:
Order TF203
1 CCS cable
QA23-24 and QA241-242
Thank you for understanding.
Best regards,
Francisco
